questions.question: Five volts is applied to ten 2 ohm resistors connected in series. The resulting current is

explanations.a: Too high; total resistance is 20 ohms, current = V/R = 5/20.

questions.question: Ten volts is applied to two 10 ohm resistors in series. The resulting voltage across one resistor is

explanations.a: Correct. Voltage divides equally across identical series resistors.
explanations.b: Too low; each resistor gets half the total voltage.
explanations.c: This is total voltage, not per resistor.

questions.question: Six volts is applied to a 2 ohm resistor in series with two 2 ohm resistors connected in parallel. The current through one of the parallel resistors is

explanations.a: Too high; check total resistance and distribution.
explanations.b: Too high; only partial voltage appears across each parallel resistor.
explanations.c: Correct. Parallel combination = 1Ω, total R = 3Ω, I = 6/3 = 2A. Current splits equally: 1A.

questions.question: Calculate the voltage V at the terminal of 3 ohm resistor at 3 A current source.

explanations.a: Correct. V = IR = 3 A × 1 Ω = 3 V.

questions.question: 10 volt is applied to three resistors 5, 10 and 20 ohm, in series. What will be the voltage across the resistor 10 ohm?

explanations.a: Too low; check voltage division formula.
explanations.b: Too low; double check resistance ratios.
